### A note on scope

SikBodo is deliberately a **static site with no build step and no runtime
dependencies**, and it is designed to work offline from the file system. Features that
require a server, user accounts, tracking or third-party CDNs are out of scope — see
[`docs/ROADMAP.md`](../../docs/ROADMAP.md) for the current boundaries. Proposals that
respect those constraints are very welcome.
